content: Dlati a Tasalonika
Bulus nǝ Sila is ɓeu tya Ampibolis nǝ Apolloniya, is mbǝ Tasalonika, lu u' nǝ lu dobga ki Yahudawa ɗa.
Kan unǝ kuɗa u, i Bulus te'ge' lu dobga, gas cin shuti maki ati shoti bi ne'si ge' lwabbati,
Ti dlimissi nǝ ndǝlti tǝn Almasihu nǝn tlebbǝna atl hiliya ɗǝge' mi'mǝshti. I' usu, “Yesu u nǝ ami dlǝmikini u tikǝ Almasihu.”
Genge' Yahudawa is dǝgi is maga nǝ Bulus isǝ Sila, nǝgu hwu' mi' Helinawa mi'ɓanti' Lya ne' bas mudli bǝ tengulen wai.

Amma na Yahudawa yen kum dutugi; is yem mi' ndǝtl ki ga tye' ge'lu utl lǝɓa taka, is dom mbalǝn is tlǝl dlati age' gatli. Is lǝ libi ki Yason, si ngau Bulus isǝ Silas gaki sǝppekkǝlsi to' kina ɗǝ hwu' mbalǝn.
Ama nǝbǝ sa mbisi wai u, is dǝl Yason ne' na mi'bǝdl Yesu kal te' akina ɗǝ mi'kǝndǝ' dlom kige' gatli, asi la'ti Yal si usu: “Mbalǝn i nǝ ɗǝ tlǝl gatllya i sinngi sa mbǝki i,
i Yason njesi libi ɗa'ka. Muswasǝn si nge' bǝtl zhil ki Kaisal, si usu, gu wonɗa, si mbeti ki Yesu.”
Nǝs kum gu u, i hwu' mbalǝn ne' mi' kǝndǝ' dlom kige gatli i mbadlwasǝn tlǝh.
Sa za'si pa is zǝgawai sai nǝs kan up ɓatlti ma' Yason ne' yelsǝniwasi.
Mi' kina a Biliya
Nǝ gas pǝ u, i mi'bǝdl Yesu kal shin Bulus nǝ Silas Tya Biliya. Nǝs mbǝkǝci tya ka u, is tege' lu dobga ki Yahudawa.
Yahudawa ki Biliya ngǝtl ki Tasalonika nǝ zo' mbadli, gaki sa kan shilǝni nǝ lyamti, asi ya' lwabbati hu anǝmi sǝ' eni ko ulnǝ Bulus dlimi u balini.
Gaki gu, dǝɓǝli ge'si is la'mbadli, hal ne' bas mudli ki Helinawa ne' mwani Helinawa diɓǝli.
Amma nǝ Yahudawa ki Tasalonika kum Bulus ɗǝ dlib shilǝn ki Lya a Biliya u, i gen lǝ tyaka asi co'tisi asi tlǝl mbadlwasǝn.
Alǝbi alǝbi i mi'bǝtl Yesu kal shin Bulus tya dlǝlka, amma Silas nǝ Timoty is dlil a Biliya.
Gini la' Bulus shitu i is mbilti a Atina, i Bulus za'si nǝ zhil sǝppi Silas nǝ Timothy sǝ'su mbǝti.
Bulus a Atina
Nǝ Bulus ɗǝ ɓuttisi a Atina u, i'kum dutugi gaki gatli a njikǝn i nǝ lya ki mi' pǝtl gonti.
I' gob shotti bi ne' Yahudawa nǝ Helinawa mi'ɓanti' Lya age' lu dobga ki Yahudawa, nǝ ge'lu dobga ki ulti nǝ ulti taka hu cin u kǝnǝ ginǝ ta mbisi lǝbi u.

I dobga ki Abikuliyawa nǝ Sitokiyawa mi' ma' lǝɓa is gob shotti bi ne'ti. Nami ge'si ngemi, “Ya mul shilǝn hutu ɗǝ lyap dlǝmti ngu?” I gen usu, “Ɗǝ yedli mul bǝtl lya ki Atlen kǝni.” Sǝ dlǝmǝn gu u gaki Bulus ɗǝ dlǝp shilǝn mul tǝmti tǝn Yesu nǝ hillya was ge' mi'mǝshti.
Is kanti is tolti tǝn ɗani ki Alasa, lu unǝ mil dlǝtl shilǝn ɗǝ dopga ɗa u alǝbi is ultisu, “Kǝn dlimimi yakǝn pyal kushti u ɗǝ mbillitiya?
Ki mbǝllimi sǝmbǝl shilǝn a kǝm ɗami, mi' lyamti tǝn man ulnǝ ɗǝ dlǝmti u.”
(Mus Atinawa ne' sǝmbǝlsi ginǝ ɗǝ dǝb Atina u, si dǝb katl ba pǝtl ulǝn, amma sai kub sǝmbǝl shilǝn, nǝ mbǝlti tǝnki.)
I Bulus hilya a dlom ki mi' dlǝtl shilǝn i' usu: “Mbalǝn ki Atina! Ayeni i hu tǝn shitu u kǝni kini mi' ngau ma' Lya kǝni.
Nǝ ami duttya u, ami ya' ulnǝ ki pǝli' mi'bǝtl Lya u, hal ya mbi bagadi ki kyetl lǝɓa nǝ lashti tǝnki ɗǝ usu: Tǝn Lya u nǝ bǝ mantwai u. To ulnǝ ki bǝtlti kalu ki manǝntwai gu a mbǝ ta dlimi kini.
“Lya unǝ pǝl dǝb lǝɓa nǝ mus ulnǝ giɓi u tikǝ Lya ki lya nǝ atli tiɗa dǝbge' lu dobga u nǝ mbalǝn kǝni nǝ toh uwai.
Nǝgu ni tiɗa ngau ɗǝtl ma' mbalǝnwai. Amma t inǝ gawas kǝn tibǝl mus mbalǝn dli nǝ shu'ti nǝ mus lǝɓa.
Tǝn mul nǝm kǝn tǝpǝl mus mbalǝn, gaki sǝ dǝb hu una adǝp lǝɓa ɗa; idlillisi dǝmtwasǝn nǝ bisi ki atlwasǝn.
Lya pǝlǝn gu u gaki sǝn ngauti ɗa agon as mbiti, ko nǝ bǝ tiɗa lolu nǝ nǝmi nǝn wai u.
‘Gaki tu' ma'ti mǝ mbi dli ɗa, ami mallǝd ɗa nǝ ndal lǝɓa inǝn ɗa.’ Kan unǝ na mi' utl ulwakǝn dlimi' u, ‘Mima u nduwas kǝni.’
“Gaki nǝgu tun nǝ mini gǝski Lya kǝn u, mǝkǝn usu kǝnǝ zinaliya ko azulpa, ko yegǝn wai, ulnǝ mulǝn pǝli' nǝ manti wasi.
A te'ɓo Lya a zakǝn mbalǝn ge' lǝshi matiwasǝn, amma nǝguni ti bǝl mbalǝn zhil hu a una sǝppal tem ma' Lya.
Tun nǝ ta zi dǝblǝɓa cin ki zǝ' ɓatlti ki ci'gontu, tu' ma' mulnǝ' la'tu. Tǝn tlǝlti mulu ɗǝ ge' mi'mǝshti ila mbalǝn ɗǝ ndǝti.”
Nǝs kum shilǝn ki mi'tlǝllya ge' mi'mǝshtu, i nami la'ki'bi, amma i nami usu, “Mi lyab kub ki ɗaɗanu tǝn shilǝn u.”
Tǝn gu Bulus za'si.
Nami ge' mbalǝni is bǝl Bulus kal is la'mbadli. Age' si hal ni Diyonisiya, yakǝn majelisa ki Alasa, nǝ kǝlion mul shin Damalisa, ne'gen.
